policy: Failures and rejected paths remain evidence and are not reclassified as successes.

entries.summary: The first non-login SSH shell did not expose PostgreSQL on PATH.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use the explicit Homebrew psql path on the accepted run.

entries.summary: The first token issue command omitted the required expires-at value.
entries.accepted_resolution: Issue bounded client and operator tokens with explicit expiry.

entries.summary: The first vector API path did not use the Mac login Keychain wrapper.
entries.accepted_resolution: Run the retrieval worker through the SiliconFlow Keychain wrapper.

entries.summary: The first OpenClaw launch used an incompatible hashed gateway runtime.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use the package-locked OpenClaw 2026.6.11 runtime.

entries.summary: An isolated Grok wrapper injected a second --verbatim argument.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use the managed Grok wrapper directly; argv tracing confirmed Vermory emits one --verbatim argument.

entries.summary: The first five formation attempts ended in provider failure while the wrapper path was being corrected.
entries.accepted_resolution: The accepted run completed formation on its first attempt with grok-cli/grok-4.5.

entries.summary: A credential-prefixed synthetic fixture was masked by OpenClaw before the Vermory hook and therefore could not prove pre-persistence rejection of the original bytes.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use an exact synthetic api_token assignment that reaches the hook and prove that no tool-result row is stored.

entries.summary: The first post-delete model response did not explicitly state that capacity was unavailable.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use a fresh transcript and a strict no-guessing output contract, then verify the delivery and retrieval audit independently.

entries.summary: Two remote SQL probes failed because UUID literals were quoted incorrectly.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use heredoc SQL with explicit uuid casts.

entries.summary: Deleting one of two memories formed from the same tool result redacted the complete observation and destroyed the surviving sibling provenance.
entries.accepted_resolution: Commit 7e76df6 redacts only the forgotten byte span while a live sibling exists and redacts the full observation only after the last sibling is deleted.

entries.summary: Direct LAN SSH timed out because the operator workstation was not on the Mac mini LAN.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use the existing Qingdao reverse-management tunnel to Mac mini port 22.

entries.summary: sessions.delete requested an operator scope upgrade and was rejected before mutation.
entries.accepted_resolution: Do not delete the session; use the official in-place reset lifecycle.

entries.summary: The package-locked CLI could not self-approve its own operator scope upgrade and produced another pending request.
entries.accepted_resolution: Do not mutate gateway device authorization for evidence collection.

entries.summary: A standalone /reset submitted through the loopback WebChat route was recorded but not authorized as a reset command.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use OpenClaw's exported performGatewaySessionReset maintenance primitive.

entries.summary: sessions.reset and a device-free gateway client were both rejected because the configured loopback credential did not grant operator.admin.
entries.accepted_resolution: Run the official local reset primitive as the user who owns the isolated state; no transcript file or session store was edited directly.

entries.summary: The first credential-free snapshot query nested count inside jsonb_agg and PostgreSQL rejected the aggregate shape.
entries.accepted_resolution: Pre-aggregate tool counts in a CTE before building the JSON object.

entries.summary: The first RLS query assumed pg_tables exposed forcerowsecurity.
entries.accepted_resolution: Read relrowsecurity and relforcerowsecurity from pg_class.

entries.summary: OpenClaw reported missing generated setup modules for bundled iMessage and Telegram channels.
entries.accepted_resolution: Neither channel was enabled or used; WebChat, the Vermory plugin, and the selected model path remained operational.

entries.summary: The workstation Grok OAuth refresh token was also rejected, so the local auth file was not a valid asset to copy to the Mac mini.
entries.accepted_resolution: Do not sync expired credentials; preserve the original Grok formation evidence and use an already provisioned provider for later windows.

entries.summary: A one-shot worker launched from the SSH shell could not read the Mac login Keychain.
entries.accepted_resolution: Run provider workers as user LaunchAgents through the existing Keychain wrapper.

entries.summary: DeepSeek-V4-Flash wrapped otherwise structured output in a Markdown code fence.
entries.accepted_resolution: Keep the strict JSON boundary; record invalid_provider_output and create no candidate.

entries.summary: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct returned valid JSON but referenced an evidence observation outside the one-item manifest.
entries.accepted_resolution: Reject the batch with evidence_observation_outside_manifest and preserve zero semantic effects.

entries.summary: SiliconFlow returned HTTP 403 Model disabled for Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507.
entries.accepted_resolution: Treat provider availability as external state; do not reinterpret the request as a model result.

entries.summary: MiniMax-M2.5 returned malformed provider JSON.
entries.accepted_resolution: Keep the strict parser and record invalid_provider_output without forming a candidate.

entries.summary: SiliconFlow returned HTTP 403 Model disabled for GLM-4.6.
entries.accepted_resolution: Stop recovery attempts, retain all eight post-delete failure rows, preserve the cumulative attempt counter at ten, and leave the failed window bounded above the current maximum.

entries.summary: A generic uv run pytest invocation failed because pytest is not declared by the locked Hermes test environment.
entries.accepted_resolution: Run the official locked unittest command from the Hermes integration README; 6 of 6 tests passed.

entries.summary: The first final pollution check found two stale Python 3.13 __pycache__ directories created by the earlier rejected pytest path.
entries.accepted_resolution: Remove only those generated cache directories, rerun the official locked unittest with bytecode disabled, and recheck that no .venv or __pycache__ remains.

entries.summary: The first local jq assertion for the final snapshot had an unmatched parenthesis and did not execute.
entries.accepted_resolution: Correct the expression and rerun the eight-attempt, shared-evidence, and delivered-memory assertions successfully.

entries.summary: The first accepted artifact stream used a remote path containing a literal $HOME directory component.
entries.accepted_resolution: Retain the complete hash-matching ZIP and move it inside the Mac mini to the intended W23 evidence root without redownloading.

entries.summary: The first post-move one-line SHA display had an awk escaping error.
entries.accepted_resolution: Leave the artifact unchanged and run a separate remote-only byte-count and SHA-256 check that matched the GitHub Artifact API values.

entries.summary: The first full verifier was rejected in the local JavaScript orchestration layer because shell variable braces were parsed as template interpolation.
entries.accepted_resolution: Record that no SSH connection or remote change occurred and rerun with interpolation-safe shell variable forms.

entries.summary: The second full verifier rejected the Mac mini because ripgrep was not installed in the noninteractive path.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use the existing system grep for the same bounded package scans without installing or downloading anything.

entries.summary: The third verifier treated grep's expected no-match status as a pipefail failure after reaching the privacy stage.
entries.accepted_resolution: Directly confirm all three scans had zero output, explicitly count no-match as zero, and rerun the privacy assertions.

entries.summary: The first independent manifest recheck ran outside the evidence root, so all 74 relative paths failed and an unconditional status print was rejected.
entries.accepted_resolution: Regenerate the manifest after updating the ledger, change to the evidence root, use set -e, and require every checksum line to pass.

entries.summary: GitHub Actions reported that pinned actions targeting Node.js 20 were forced onto Node.js 24.
entries.accepted_resolution: Retain the non-fatal annotation; every protected workflow step completed successfully.

entries.summary: The first post-rsync public-ledger hash comparison had another nested remote awk escaping error.
entries.accepted_resolution: Keep the synced file, read plain remote shasum output, and parse the digest on the workstation before comparing it with the local digest.

entries.summary: The first combined pre-commit static assertion treated ripgrep's no-match output as an empty string instead of a zero unchecked-item count.
entries.accepted_resolution: Use an explicit awk count for unchecked checklist rows and require the resulting numeric count to equal zero.

entries.summary: The first final-head run discovery loop guessed the full commit SHA from its short form and waited for a non-existent value.
entries.accepted_resolution: Cancel the loop, read the exact SHA with git rev-parse, and select run 29640295425 from the actual head value.

entries.summary: Protected run 29640295425 failed because a legacy 50 ms request deadline expired before BeginSourceMatch committed under CI load.
entries.accepted_resolution: Preserve the failed run and make the test trigger a controllable request deadline only after the pending source match is persisted; production timeout behavior remains unchanged.
